program: E: classical integer factorization, finite combinatorial analysis only
prior_art_gate: Completed before experiment implementation: extensive overlap in full-period counts and modulus selection; exact bounded minimax table not located; novelty unestablished
question: For each short length h, which raw residue-table moduli minimize the uniform worst-case number of admitted positions under a 256-bit table payload limit?
mask: f(m,n,a)=1 iff a*a-n is a square modulo m, including zero

domain.n: all residues 0 <= n < m with gcd(n,m)=1
domain.objective: F_m(h)=max over n and s of sum_{j=0}^{h-1} f(m,n,s+j); G_B(h)=min_{1<=m<=B} F_m(h)

representation.persistent_table_bits: exactly m logical bits for one full raw period at the current n
representation.limitation: Representation-specific budget, not optimal compressed memory. Even-modulus masks can have period dividing m/2.

checks: Attaining n/start witness for every modulus and length
hypotheses: Full-period worst-density ordering need not agree with finite-window minimax ordering
A finite exact optimum profile may be certifiable
Any novel theorem or table claim requires separate literature assessment
boundaries: Finite synthetic residue masks only; no arbitrary-input factorization, key recovery, deployed tests, accounts, services, external sends or publication
interpretation: Worst case over arbitrary intervals and unit residues; no equivalence claimed to the correlated start and endpoint of an actual Fermat search. Counts are not timings.
